subject: Re: [knitr] Why do graphics look better when produced in LyX via knitr?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Why do graphics look better when produced in LyX via knitr?
parts:
knitr uses the PDF device in LaTeX by default, and PDF is a vector
graphics format (it may also contain pixel data, though), which often
looks better than raster graphics (e.g. bmp)

Regards,
Yihui

On Mon, Aug 20, 2012 at 1:58 PM, Gary Moser <gary....@csueastbay.edu> wrote:
> Hi All,
> I have a report I create on a semi-regular basis that has two ggplot
> graphics written to it. Previously, I used XLConnect to write the graphics
> in .bmp format to a defined range in an Excel workbook. It worked very well,
> except the graphics looked fuzzy, and even worse when printed. After I
> migrated this report to a LyX + knitr workflow, the graphics look vastly
> better and print beautifully. I feel like I really need to understand why
> this happened so I can avoid ever having such ugly output again - thanks in
> advance for sharing your expertise.
> -Gary
